mapper.sql: event_id, order_id, event_type, status, attempts, next_retry_at, lease_until, last_error, created_at, updated_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO refund_notification_task (order_id, event_type, status, attempts, next_retry_at) VALUES (#{orderId}, #{eventType}, #{status}, 0, #{nextRetryAt,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE status = status
mapper.select: SELECT FROM refund_notification_task WHERE order_id = #{orderId} ORDER BY event_id

SELECT FROM refund_notification_task WHERE (status = 'PENDING' AND (next_retry_at IS NULL OR next_retry_at <= #{now})) OR (status = 'PROCESSING' AND lease_until IS NOT NULL AND lease_until < #{now}) ORDER BY COALESCE(next_retry_at, created_at), event_id LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE refund_notification_task SET status = 'PROCESSING', lease_until = #{leaseUntil}, attempts = attempts + 1, updated_at = #{now} WHERE event_id = #{eventId} AND ((status = 'PENDING' AND (next_retry_at IS NULL OR next_retry_at <= #{now})) OR (status = 'PROCESSING' AND lease_until IS NOT NULL AND lease_until < #{now}))
